t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
I=G['Demo pair 2 input']; O=G['Demo pair 2 output']
IH,IW=len(I),len(I[0]); OH,OW=len(O),len(O[0])
sepr=[i for i in range(IH) if len(set(I[i]))==1]
sepc=[j for j in range(IW) if len({I[i][j] for i in range(IH)})==1]
from collections import Counter
cnt=Counter(v for row in I for v in row); fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
print("d2: seprows",sepr,"sepcols",sepc,"fill",fill,"OH,OW",OH,OW)
# markers: all non-fill
marks=[(r,c,int(I[r][c])) for r in range(IH) for c in range(IW) if int(I[r][c])!=fill]
print("num markers:",len(marks))
print(cnt)
# hypothesis: bands split by separators; tile = region between sep lines; marker in tile → output cell = color
# bands: regions between consecutive sep-rows/cols; tiles = floodfill of fill color
def blocks(I,sepr,sepc):
    IH,IW=len(I),len(I[0])
    rs=[0]+sepr+[IH]; cs=[0]+sepc+[IW]
    blks=[]; seen=[[False]*IW for _ in range(IH)]
    for bi in range(len(rs)-1):
        for bj in range(len(cs)-1):
            q=collections.deque(); cells=[]
            for i in range(rs[bi],rs[bi+1]):
                for j in range(cs[bj],cs[bj+1]):
                    if I[i][j]==fill and not seen[i][j]:
                        seen[i][j]=True; q.append((i,j)); cells.append((i,j))
            blks.append(cells)
    return blks
blks=blocks(I,sepr,sepc)
print("num blocks:",len(blks))
# distribution of markers among blocks
from collections import defaultdict
mapm=defaultdict(list)
for r,c,v in marks:
    bi=r; bc=c
    # find containing block
    for blk in blks:
        if min(p[0] for p in blk)<=r<=max(p[0] for p in blk) and min(p[1] for p in blk)<=c<=max(p[1] for p in blk):
            mapm[(bi,bc)].append((r,c,v)); break
print(sorted(mapm.items()))

    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def candidates_for_seps(sr,sc,I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); fill=collections.Counter(v for row in I for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sepcolor=None
    # marker cells = non-fill, non-separator-color cells
    return sr,sc,fill

# Inspect separators more carefully in each demo
for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 2 input','Demo pair 3 input']:
    I=G[k]; IH,IW=len(I),len(I[0])
    sr=[i for i in range(IH) if len(set(I[i]))==1]

    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def features(I):
    IH,IW=len(I),len(I[0]); c=collections.Counter(v for row in I for v in row); fill=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sr=[i for i in range(IH) if len(set(I[i]))==1]
    sc=[j for j in range(IW) if len({I[i][j] for i in range(IH)})==1]
    mks=((r,c,int(v)) for r in range(IH) for c,v in enumerate(I[r]) if v!=fill)
    return {'IH':IH,'IW':IW,'fill':fill,'sr':sr,'sc':sc,'mks':sorted(list(mks)), 'cnt':dict(c)}

import os,re,json,numpy as np,collections,bisect, itertools, random
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def f_params(I):
    a=np.array(I)
    # bg = most common color
    bg=collections.Counter(a.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=a.shape
    
    # separator lines: full rows or full cols of a SINGLE color (that color may vary)
    sr=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(a[i]))==1]
    sepc=[j for j in range(w) if len({a[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    
    # marker rows = rows containing any cell not bg and not on seprows/sepcs, plus sep-line deviation cells
    # markers: any cell whose value is not bg and whose value differs from the uniform color of its line (if on a separator)
    # simpler: marker = cell not bg AND NOT lying in a full-uniform row OR full-uniform col... but demo4 seps cols are uniform 7 but contain 1/2/3
    # unify: separators = lines (rows/cols) whose ALL cells equal some color; markers = cells on those lines differing from line-color
    seplines=[]
    for r in range(h):
        cl=set(a[r]); if len(cl)==1: seplines.append(('r',r,int(a[r][0])))
    for c in range(w):
        cl=set(a[i][c] for i in range(h)); if len(cl)==1: seplines.append(('c',c,int(a[0][c])))
    sep_colors={t: int(a[x][y]) for t,x,y in seplines}
    mk=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=int(a[r][c])
            # marker candidate if v!=bg, and the line containing (r,c) is a separator line
            on_sep = any(t=='r' and r==y or t=='c' and c==y for t,y in zip(['r']*h,['r']*h,range(h))) 
            on_line=False
            ismar=False
            for t,x,color in seplines:
                if t=='r' and r==x and a[r][c]!=color: ismar=True
                if t=='c' and c==x and a[r][c]!=color: ismar=True
            if v!=bg and ismar: mk.append((int(r),int(c),v))
    return bg,a,h,w,sr,sepc,mk,seplines
